currentDecision: Continue Phase 0; the current artifact groups Recovery backup/restore, repair/platform, and local-retirement controls behind labelled native disclosures while preserving existing IDs and owner paths. Closed compact disclosures suppress non-summary content, and the active update-ledger status pill now wraps within the compact Recovery summary at narrow 200% scale; the bounded lens chip row remains an explicit local horizontal scroller. The experimental Arabic presentation profile activates document lang/RTL direction and an Arabic-capable offline fallback while safely retaining English for untranslated copy; the current receipt reports no page overflow at saved 200% scale and does not claim full Arabic support. Record-detail confidence/provenance metadata is hidden by default and explicitly revealable with a persisted preference; the current receipt reports UNKNOWN values honestly and does not fabricate conflict evidence. Bounded Share now stages the exact projection in an unskippable recipient-eye dialog, names excluded credentials/AI authority/out-of-scope links/provenance/attachments/relationships/history, and downloads only after explicit confirmation using the same JSON serializer as the preview. The current exact-artifact service-worker rehearsal stages shell changes behind explicit Recovery activation, records the update ledger, rolls back to the retained prior cache, and reloads/accepts a canonical capture offline. The artifact retains the strict pre-delivery Effect/Outbox withdrawal owner and fails closed in the core runner when an immediate transport lacks explicit approval: missing or denied approval leaves the operation PENDING, while the UI confirmation supplies approval before delivery; reconciliation remains separate. The current same-origin Chromium qualification restores an opaque broker handle after reload, authorizes one ambiguous bearer POST plus one GET reconciliation, creates one idempotent identity, and leaves no raw secret in durable state. The artifact retains the independent dependency-free last-resort recovery console at ./recovery.html, deterministic human-readable and artifact-originals exports, and a storage-owned retirement gate requiring a current full Vault readback or separately recorded explicit destroy intent. Compact/loopback evidence does not close real-provider/OAuth/ACL, native key restoration, remote deployment/rollback, target/accessibility, native fault, or human-acceptance gaps. OMN-ACC-094 remains bounded NOT_APPLICABLE and no completion or production-release claim is made.
